zh: 糞肥；（戲稱）鬼扯的爛攤子
def_en: animal waste used as fertilizer — here used as a comedic stand-in for a rude word
example: It was predicted that by the middle of the next century there would be nine feet of manure covering the streets.
speaker: jd
event: 虛構 Bloomberg 訪談橋段，Jared 用「manure」代替髒話講完整套糞肥史類比

def_en: moving somewhere in large numbers, like a crowd (from "flock to")
example: The Industrial Revolution had people flocking to the city.
speaker: jd
event: 虛構 Bloomberg 訪談橋段，Jared 講 1894 年倫敦馬糞危機類比

def_en: to destroy something completely, leaving no trace
example: No one saw coming was a new technology that would completely obliterate those concerns.
speaker: jd
event: 虛構 Bloomberg 訪談橋段，汽車讓馬糞問題一夜消失的類比收尾
